KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. watoto
   C. mitoto
   D. mato

2. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.

3. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. nene
   C. zito
   D. fupi

4. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

5. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

6. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.

7. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.

8. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.

9. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.

10. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Dukani and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Nimpendaye and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
